title: ⚖️ California Tightens AI Safety Rules!
body: The state of California announced new recommendations for mandatory safety standards for powerful AI models.

The recommendations include independent testing throughout the development stages, the power to shut down any dangerous system immediately in emergencies, and a limit on AI developing itself by itself.
Simply put, the state wants clear rules that everyone follows, instead of leaving each company to set its own rules.
Do you support imposing safety rules on AI companies? And why?
